$comment: The phone's island settings over the device channel (T-0984): AURA reads and changes the four switches under Settings, Island:
keep the island at the camera, show the phone's status in it, cover the status bar's own icons, keep conversations at the bottom.
Two phone actions carry them. `get` is free; `set` takes any of the `settings` as booleans and changes only those, all or none:
a value that is not a boolean, a name that is not one of them, or no name at all changes nothing and answers an error.
Both answer the four current values as `result.settings`. `set` also answers `changed` (the names whose value moved) and
`notes`: a switch stored on that the island does not show yet (`needs`: the switches it follows, `cover_needs_accessibility`).
A stored value is never rewritten to match a note: the owner's own toggles keep their dependants the same way.
`set` is in the house's RESERVED_ACTIONS: only the `phone_island_set` tool (an ASK row) sends it, not `phone_action` or
`house_device_action`, so the approval cannot be walked around. `get` is open to both.
Read by hermes/plugins/aura-hud/tests/test_aura_hud.py, hermes/plugins/tests/test_matrix.py and android-app IslandSettingsActionTest.
Not covered: how the island looks with a switch on (the island goldens) or the Settings screen's own toggles (SettingsScreenTest).
